author: Codex /root/likelihood_finish_reviewer
limitations: Nine completed raw RL summaries are a time-frozen snapshot, not a full18-arm or21-training-stage completion.
Training correctness and categorical frequencies are stochastic on-policy exposure, not held-out accuracy, calibrated probabilities, independent patients or improved MRI understanding.
Multiple seed outputs are not additional patients. No p values or population generalization inference.
Source proof verifier versions include independently corrected decoder/public-sanitization evidence; pinned proof hashes preserve provenance. No optimizer/decoder/native audit is repeated here.
True-label-conditioned update mechanisms, gradient influence and causal learning explanations are not identifiable from these sanitized task-level summaries.

metric_definitions.accepted_update: Actual verified optimizer updates from source proof, not task sampling allocations
metric_definitions.accepted_update_share: Task accepted updates / all accepted updates; null if no updates
metric_definitions.attempt_share: Task attempted groups / all attempted groups
metric_definitions.attempted: Complete saved rollout groups, including zero-variance and rejected groups
metric_definitions.categorical_answers: Exact allowed task strings only; every other answer key and sanitized withheld count grouped without exporting text
metric_definitions.nonzero_variance_without_update: Residual count only; public proof does not identify rejection reason or true-label-conditioned contributions
metric_definitions.tokens: Measured native input (including visual positions) plus generated tokens; crashed measured and imputed charges separate, not optimizer FLOPs
metric_definitions.update_rate: Accepted updates / attempted groups within task

minimum_justified_V2_diagnostic.interpretation_and_KILL: This three-seed/eight-prompt pilot is descriptive and cannot exclude sampling noise when counts look stable. Do not promote it to a corrective training run or claim a causal root cause from its acceptance counts. Require the complete frozen seed comparison and image controls to identify a reproducible failure before selecting a separately reviewed V2 intervention.
minimum_justified_V2_diagnostic.minimal_design: After frozen original arms and existing visual probe, consider a separately reviewed no-update common-B28 diagnostic on a prospectively hash-selected fixed8 training prompts (two per task×binary-label cell), seeds7/11/13,K4,temp1,max256;96 responses. Report within-prompt acceptance/format/label distributions, not evaluation accuracy.
minimum_justified_V2_diagnostic.necessity_limit: First use the completed frozen seed matrix and already planned image controls. This proposal is not automatically authorized, launched or required to keep the original queue running.
minimum_justified_V2_diagnostic.question: How much active-group acceptance variation persists when prompt/image/true-label case mix and initial weights are held fixed?

new_aggregate_independent_review: Coordinator review recorded separately in the root-cause report; script execution is not independent approval. Source proofs retain their actual reviewer identities.
observations_not_causes: Equal169216-token caps do not imply equal accepted optimizer updates, number of complete groups, sampled labels, response diversity or effective task exposure.
Uniform task sampling can yield different accepted-update task shares across seeds because the realized response/group filter and evolving policy differ.
A low update count or constant categorical answers is not proof of weak or strong MRI visual grounding, GSPO ineffectiveness, a code defect or held-out capability.
